audit_metadata.auditor_role: Senior ML Research Engineer & Forensic Evaluation Auditor
audit_metadata.reconciliation_verdict: The original Step 32 OOF result (F1 = 80.86%, 116 errors) is a genuinely valid, authentic, component-wise out-of-fold benchmark on the 1,900-sample Pool. The 72.07% F1 result from the initial audit was an incomplete implementation that inadvertently omitted the Step 27 anchor feature (accounting for a 4.93% - 7.70% F1 degradation) and omitted the Step 30 Severe-FN recovery layer. When the complete Step 32 architecture is retrained fold-by-fold with the Step 27 anchor, internal CV reaches 76.90% F1 (134 errors). The official Step 32 Champion benchmark remains frozen at 23 errors (87.96% F1) on the 594-record holdout and 20 errors (86.84% F1) on the 475-record confirmation set.

identified_discrepancy_drivers.impact: Degrades meta-learner performance by -4.93% to -7.70% F1 and introduces 28-39 additional errors.
identified_discrepancy_drivers.forensic_evidence: Proved experimentally in ablation study: Meta-learner with anchor achieves 79.05% F1 (123 errors) vs 71.35% F1 (163 errors) without anchor on identical data.

identified_discrepancy_drivers.factor: Omission of Step 30 Severe-FN Recovery Layer
identified_discrepancy_drivers.impact: Excludes targeted recovery rules for high-tenure, severely dissatisfied employees.
identified_discrepancy_drivers.forensic_evidence: Step 30 rules reduced errors from 123 to 120 on the 1,900 Pool samples.

identified_discrepancy_drivers.impact: Step 32 trained the boundary specialist on 9 specialized features with model probabilities (P_cb, P_lgb, P_28), whereas simplified audit CV used 30 raw features.
identified_discrepancy_drivers.forensic_evidence: Step 32 specialist achieves high precision on boundary cases; simplified specialist failed to trigger effectively.

identified_discrepancy_drivers.impact: In outer 5-fold CV, inner base models are trained on only 1,216 samples rather than 1,520 samples, reducing statistical power on minority attrition instances.

step37_original_cv_superseded.reason: Evaluated globally pre-fitted models on training fold slices (in-sample resubstitution error).
